body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 04a91df1fb816513a7698be38b1c218c8c717143 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The post change itself is sound: G92.1 in the header clears any leftover G92 offset, G97 states constant-RPM mode before the first spindle start, the `clearG92` option is correctly declared with default `true`, and the pinning tests pass. The PR does not, however, carry the app-level and golden updates the change implies, and it conflicts with main.

What looks good:
- The post change is minimal, targeted and matches issue #4151 (header, not the preamble).
- The boolean option `clearG92` is declared (assets/posts/linuxcnc.cps:98), read via an optBool fallback (assets/posts/linuxcnc.cps:425-426), and covered by tests in crates/post/tests/linuxcnc_post.rs.
- `explainWords` gains "G92.1" with a clean definition (assets/posts/linuxcnc.cps:37); the explain check accepts the sub-word form.
- The pinning tests pass (3/3), as do the linuxcnc-family post suites and clippy.

Where this was built: locally (fork PR - the pr-test.yml runner is collaborator-only, so no runner run). The trial merge with origin/main (1c0152c9106514622a641c17adc7520af45ebc6a) conflicts on the new test file, so the tree below was NOT the merged tree; tests were run on the PR head (04a91df1f) in a fresh worktree, and the two app-level suites were run on that head.

Trial merge with main: CONFLICT in crates/post/tests/linuxcnc_post.rs (add/add). Main landed issue #4152 (commit f9527378b) with the same file path and different content; the PR adds its own file at that path. The .cps change auto-merges cleanly. Per the review law I did not resolve the conflict; I reviewed the PR head instead. Do not merge until this is resolved.

Results on the PR head (local, 6 jobs):
- post pinning tests (crates/post/tests/linuxcnc_post.rs): 3/3 pass
- post suites linuxcnc-family (g83_dwell_linuxcnc, g73_g85_dwell_linuxcnc, script_linuxcnc): 22/22 pass
- app suite linuxcnc_post: 3/9 pass, 6 fail (see below)
- app conformance: 5/7 pass, 2 fail (see below)
- app suites post_spindle_rule_all and machine_library: 22/22 pass
- clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean

Conformance failures (crates/app/tests/conformance.rs:240 and :409), "is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1":
- every_builtin_posts_every_golden_byte_exact: LinuxCNC: crates/app/tests/golden/nc/linuxcnc/contour_disc_hole.nc (and the other linuxcnc goldens: 12 files, lines under 814 total, e.g. contour_plate_with_hole.nc) is stale - output now writes "G21 G17 G90 G91.1 G94 G40 G49 G80 G92.1 G97"
- the_synthesized_stream_locks_the_tool_and_spindle_words: LinuxCNC: crates/app/tests/golden/nc/synth_linuxcnc.nc is stale - same header change

App linuxcnc_post failures (crates/app/tests/linuxcnc_post.rs), 6 of 9 tests fail with the header change:
- a_floating_tap_is_g84, a_remap_that_applies_the_length_gets_no_g43_and_no_section_g49, g28_g30_and_none_retracts_move_z_only_or_nothing, path_control_end_word_and_percent_are_options, rigid_tap_needs_a_stated_encoder: all fail at assert_linuxcnc_words because CODES (crates/app/tests/linuxcnc_post.rs:38-42) lacks "G92.1" and "G97" - first failure quoted: G92.1 is not a word this post writes: "G21 G17 G90 G91.1 G94 G40 G49 G80 G92.1 G97"
- a_stated_safe_z_is_the_retract_before_m6_and_at_the_end: additionally asserts the exact header line at crates/app/tests/linuxcnc_post.rs:126 - lines.get(1) == Some(&"G21 G17 G90 G91.1 G94 G40 G49 G80") - now stale

Targeted tests (step 5):
- Example catalog: no catalog case uses the linuxcnc post - no example_catalog suites run.
- Light lane (cargo xtask gate light, release): green. 6 steps, all ok (build 691s, motion light lib 563s, adaptive_troch_island 50s, adaptive_troch_neck 26s, adaptive_troch_parallel 13s, app light pocket_pass_start 4s). 22.6 min wall; nothing red.
- Targeted heavy step: not applicable - this is a P6/effort:high post change, not a P1 under the safety floor.

Requested before merge (one fix per class):
1. Resolve the trial-merge conflict on crates/post/tests/linuxcnc_post.rs: merge main into the branch, keep the #4152 (probe guard) tests from main and the #4151 (G92/G97) tests from this PR in one file at that path, and drop the duplicate header. If a distinct file is preferred, name it differently than main's path and give the one-line reason in the PR body (AGENTS.md "New tests join a directory suite").
2. Update crates/app/tests/linuxcnc_post.rs: add "G92.1" and "G97" to CODES (line 38) and update the exact header-line assertion at line 126 to the new header line ("G21 G17 G90 G91.1 G94 G40 G49 G80 G92.1 G97"); do not weaken the assertion.
3. Regenerate the linuxcnc goldens for the app suite and the synth stream: WRITE_GOLDEN=1 on crates/app/tests/conformance.rs for the two failing assertions (the byte-exact loop and the synth stream), then read the diff and explain it in the PR body.
4. Note the fix in the PR body: goldens regenerated and the allowlist updated.

Questions / notes (not blocking):
- The PR body claims pinning tests under crates/post/tests/linuxcnc_post.rs; those pass. The PR body does not mention the app-suite and golden updates, which is why they were missed.
- No UI, MCP or command changes; no undoable command needed; no new dependency; no process-file changes. The PR body needs no "Process change: yes" line.
- The fork PR is left as its contributor set it. It is not a draft; the review leaves the draft state alone.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
